title: Specialized Fields of Artificial Intelligence
learning_outcomes: Explain the major concepts in Specialized Fields of Artificial Intelligence and connect the numbered lesson topics.
Apply a representative technique or model the decision process using a transparent example.
Describe evaluation needs, assumptions, and risks relevant to the module.

overview_visual.alt_text: Two-column lesson roadmap for Module 11: Specialized Fields of Artificial Intelligence. It lists 15 curriculum topics and ends with the workflow Observe, Experiment, Evaluate, Iterate.
overview_visual.caption: Module 11 visual roadmap: scan the ordered lesson cards, then use the Observe → Experiment → Evaluate → Iterate cycle when applying the concepts.

notes: All 15 lesson titles and their source subtopics are preserved from the AI.pdf syllabus. AI specializations reuse shared foundations but differ in data, output, evaluation, and deployment constraints. Choose a method for a defined use case. The module is draft pending subject-matter review.
